sentences.en: A spiral staircase leads onto the gallery of the church.
sentences.zh: 教堂里的螺旋楼梯通向画廊。

sentences.en: We risk tilting ourselves into a downward spiral of defeatism.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会陷入失败主义的恶性循环。

sentences.en: Yanni's letter sent Rima into a downward spiral of self-hatred.
sentences.zh: 亚尼的信件让里马陷入了自我憎恨的恶性循环。

senses.zh: 使成螺旋形；使作螺旋形上升
盘旋；成螺旋形；螺旋形上升（过去式spiraled/spiralled，过去分词spiraled/spiralled，现在分词spiraling/spiralling，第三人称单数spirals，副词spirally）
